items.title: AbbVie (ABBV) Stock Looks Below Fair Value After Strong Cash Flow Growth
items.summary: AbbVie has delivered a strong share price run in recent years, and with the stock around US$295 the key question is how firmly its current market value rests on the cash it can generate over time. The stock has returned 203.1% over 5 years, which places substantial expectations into the price and makes the link between that gain and AbbVie’s long term cash generation the central issue.
